en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Mihran, from Muhammad Bin Ali , from Ibn Muhriz, from Ali Bin Yaqteen, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘He<sup>asws</sup> wrote to me from the prison: ‘So and so son<sup>asws</sup> of mine<sup>asws</sup> is the chief of my<sup>asws</sup> children, and<sup>asws</sup> have gifted my<sup>asws</sup> teknonym to him<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ahmad ibn Mihran has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ali from ibn Muhriz from Ali ibn Yaqtin who has said the following.
“Abu al-Hassan (a.s.) wrote to me from prison that so and so my son is the master and guardian of my children and I have gifted my own (Kunya, Arabic) surname.”
